meta.title: Update hufilter URLs to jsDelivr CDN and add missing EF migration
meta.body_summary: Updated hufilter filter list URLs from deprecated raw GitHub URLs to jsDelivr CDN for better reliability and performance; added missing EF Core migration and updated copilot instructions.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot missed EF migration; maintainer requested fix and agent added it within 9 minutes; merged quickly.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At over 88,000 changed lines, this is a large edit by absolute volume, but the bulk is an auto-generated EF migration Designer file (~88k lines). The substantive change is just 2 URL lines in JSON and a few lines in copilot instructions. It fits a very small scope data fix PR, and the large auto-generated file is expected in .NET EF migrations. The merge was fast and expected for this kind of infrastructure change.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer collinbarrett requested that Copilot add the missing EF Core migration to capture the URL changes and update copilot-instructions.md to prevent future oversights.
review_details.performance_claim: jsDelivr CDN provides better reliability and performance compared to raw GitHub URLs.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent successfully performed the intended data change but omitted a required EF Core migration step, violating repository conventions. The maintainer caught this and the agent fixed it, illustrating a gap in following domain-specific processes for .NET data migrations.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer collinbarrett reviewed the PR diff and noticed the missing EF Core migration, requesting the agent to add it.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: New CDN URLs return HTTP 200, old URLs 404; performance improvement is narrative without benchmark.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Agent added the missing EF migration and updated copilot instructions in the same PR; merged immediately after.

core_change_summary.description: Updated two hufilter filter-list URLs in FilterListViewUrl.json from raw.githubusercontent.com to cdn.jsdelivr.net, and added an EF Core migration to reflect the URL changes in the database, along with copilot-instructions.md update.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The Designer.cs is a large auto-generated file; global.json had unrelated SDK version bumps; packages-microsoft-prod.deb was added then removed as part of bot environment changes.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and URL update in FilterListViewUrl.json.
Maintainer comment requesting EF migration and instructions update.
Agent commit added EF migration (Designer.cs, .cs, snapshot update) and enhanced copilot-instructions.md.
